response.overview: Defeat One is a trilogy in Battle for Dream Island: The Power of Two,  consisting of episodes 23, 24, and 25! It is the first trilogy in the Battle for Dream Island series that spans across one challenge and the third challenge overall which takes up more than one episode. "Homeward Bound!", the first in the trilogy, was released exclusively on YouTube on June 28, 2026 (PDT). "That's What Foes Are For",  the second in the trilogy, was released on YouTube on August 16, 2026 (EST). And “All for One”, which released on August 31, 2026 (EST). The trilogy consists of the titular challenge wherein the contestants attempt to defeat One, after which the merge will occur. The trilogy has also been stated to feature the culmination of several plot-lines in TPOT, as well as revealing Three's current status inside the EXIT.
response.tagline: Defeat her once and for all.
response.title: Defeat One
